title: Console: gating results panel + failure explanation UI for Optimize apply
creator: Aditya Rao
description:
Problem
Optimize can propose cost-saving changes (batching/caching/quantization/routing) that risk quality regressions. The apply flow must surface the gating outcome clearly and actionably so users understand why an apply is blocked and what to do next.

Scope (this ticket)
Implement the Console UI/UX for displaying guardrails gating results during the Optimize “Apply changes” flow.
- Results panel that shows:
  - Overall status (PASS / FAIL / TIMEOUT / ERROR / PARTIAL)
  - Eval suite name(s) executed + versions/revisions (model version, prompt set revision, threshold policy version)
  - Key metrics table with deltas vs baseline and pass/fail per metric
  - Links to artifacts (eval run summary + per-suite artifacts) and copyable eval_run_id
- Failure explanation UI:
  - Human-readable reason summary (e.g., “Rubric score dropped below threshold”, “Formatting compliance regression”, “Min sample size not met”, “Eval runner timeout”)
  - Suggested next steps (rerun, adjust prompt set coverage, request override if permitted)
  - Clear callouts for when gating is blocking vs observe-only (feature-flag stage)

Non-scope
- Defining thresholds/stat rules (Applied ML)
- Implementing eval runner and persistence
- Creating dashboards/alerts (separate observability ticket)

User stories
1) As an engineer applying an Optimize recommendation, I can see whether gating passed and which metrics drove the decision.
2) As an engineer, if gating fails I can quickly determine whether it’s a true quality regression vs infra flake (timeout/min sample) and know what to do next.
3) As an admin/oncall, I can retrieve the eval_run_id and jump to artifacts to debug or support a customer.
4) As an enterprise operator (where allowed), I can request an override and provide justification (this UI should link to override path, but the override workflow implementation is tracked under ENG-3920).

UX requirements / states
- Inline panel in the apply drawer/modal (right rail) after user clicks “Run checks” or “Apply” (final behavior depends on PM decision; implement component to support either).
- State machine:
  - Not run: show “Quality checks not run yet” + CTA (when applicable)
  - Running: progress indicator + “Estimated time” (optional) + link to job id
  - Pass: green status + metric summary (top 3 metrics + expand to full table)
  - Fail: red status + top failure reasons + metrics table + “What changed?” section if available
  - Timeout/Error: amber status + infra hint + retry CTA (respect backoff; do not spam runner)
  - Partial: some suites completed, others failed/timeout; show what’s missing and whether decision is blocking
- Copy must be consistent with legal/customer wording guidance (see Drive doc on UI copy states; Kenji has the latest).

Data contract (assumptions)
Console will consume a “gating run summary” API (implemented/owned under console backend) that includes at minimum:
- gating_status
- decision (allow / block / allow_with_override)
- decision_reason_codes (stable enums)
- metric_results[] with: metric_name, baseline_value, candidate_value, delta, threshold, pass_fail, confidence_interval (optional), sample_size
- metadata: eval_run_id, model_id + version, prompt_set_revision, suite_ids, threshold_policy_version
- artifact links: run_summary_url, artifacts_base_url (or list)

Acceptance criteria
- UI renders a gating results panel for all states (pass/fail/timeout/error/partial/not-run/running) with consistent styling and accessible semantics (aria labels for status + table).
- Metrics table supports sorting by “failed first” and hides empty optional fields gracefully (e.g., no CI for deterministic checks).
- When FAIL, user sees:
  - at least 1–3 primary failure reasons mapped from reason codes
  - per-metric pass/fail and deltas
  - direct link to artifacts + copyable eval_run_id
- When TIMEOUT/ERROR, user sees:
  - clear messaging that checks did not complete
  - CTA to retry (if permitted by backend response)
  - (for soft-block/observe-only) apply affordance clearly labeled and gated by feature flag
- Deep links are stable (open artifacts in new tab) and do not leak tenant-sensitive identifiers outside of authenticated session.
- Basic instrumentation:
  - Track UI impressions for each gating state
  - Track clicks: artifact link, retry, request override

Implementation notes
- Frontend: add <GuardrailsGatingPanel /> component within Optimize apply flow.
- Backend dependency: endpoint that returns run summary (ENG-18496). For now, stub with mocked response in storybook/tests until backend lands.
- Use feature flag(s) to conditionally render panel + behavior for observe-only vs blocking stages (see ENG-3926/feature flags PR).
- Ensure we do not introduce high-cardinality client-side logging (no per-prompt details; only run ids + coarse enums).

Links
- Confluence (UX spec): optimize-apply-flow-gating-ux-spec
- Drive (UI copy/states): guardrails-ui-copy-and-states
- GitHub (planned): console frontend PR to add panel + states

Open questions
- Do we show raw metric values by default, or only deltas unless expanded? (Kenji preference: show deltas + threshold, with expand for raw.)
- For PARTIAL results, do we compute a tentative decision in UI or rely strictly on backend decision field? (Prefer backend authoritative.)
- Do we allow “Apply anyway” affordance in observe-only stage? (PM decision; must align with enforcement stage and customer tier.)

2025-01-20 (Chloe Martin): Backend summary endpoint spec is close; will include decision_reason_codes + artifact links. CI fields may be omitted for some metrics; please handle nulls.
2025-01-23 (Jordan Lee): Please do not infer allow/block from metric rows in the client. Decision logic lives in policy engine; UI should treat decision as authoritative and only explain it.

2025-01-28 (Dylan Brooks): Implemented initial component scaffolding behind feature flag optimize_guardrails_ui_panel. Added storybook fixtures for PASS/FAIL/TIMEOUT and table rendering with failed-first sort.

2025-01-30 (Aditya Rao): Confirmed we need explicit language distinguishing: (a) checks failed (quality regression) vs (b) checks didn’t complete (timeout). Also include CTA to ‘Rerun checks’ where applicable.

2025-02-03 (Felix Schneider): Instrumentation: please emit UI events with fields {tenant_tier, gating_status, decision, has_override_affordance}. Avoid including model version string in client analytics; backend will join via eval_run_id if needed.

2025-02-06 (Dylan Brooks): Blocked on backend returning stable reason code enums; current mapping table uses placeholder strings. If backend can land codes this week, we can finish copy + next steps section and ship to pilot.
